precision: original -O FP16 autocast and original default GradScaler; no fallback
training_kernel: Unmodified original Trainer.train_step and Trainer.train_one_epoch. Original AdamW groups/defaults, per-attempt LambdaLR, lip/patch alternation, EMA0.95 every1000 attempts retained.
pairing: One full random generator state per identity/seed; three arms strict load same state. Per-epoch frame permutation and per-attempt actual pixel-index hashes compared across gains; occupancy and render/regularization use isolated same per-step RNG domains. Treatment-dependent occupancy and gradients may differ.
epoch_interleaving: Run one full6000-frame epoch per arm. Same-phase process resumption restores original full checkpoint, post-validation statistics and renderer non-buffer counters; strict tensor-tree verification is required. Fine-phase first epoch uses a fresh original model/Trainer and own arm coarse-final full checkpoint, retaining original phase-boundary counter resets and fine LR lambda.
optimizer_updates: Count actual AdamW calls with step post-hook, record every AMP skip and scale. Compare successful update totals at each phase end; unequal phase budgets invalidate a paired block. No coupled skips, scaler tuning, extra-step compensation or precision changes.
validation: All fixed750 validation frames after each epoch, all three gain drivers;0dB is the shared primary learning curve, +/-6 secondary. Original eval_step and EMA store/copy/restore, FP16 preserved. Validation restores Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/CUDA RNG exactly and changes no optimizer or scheduler state. No test checkpoint selection.
logging_only_adaptations: Compact per-frame MSE and a few fixed previews replace five PNGs per validation frame. Checkpoint persistence/rotation is outer I/O only; keep exact own coarse-final, latest full phase states, canonical initial state and explicit final EMA. No unverified unique history deletion.
final_ema: Clone EMA-applied complete model tensors before restoring raw parameters, retain final density buffers and metadata. Do not assume the original best writer's state_dict references survived its EMA restore as EMA weights.
qualification_only: Loading and capacity tests may run without any optimizer step before all identity gates. Full training requires all four data gates, persisted source/derived inputs, loader parity, complete initialization and actual full-ray resource checks.
source_pinning: Capture exact executing controller/helpers/protocol and original network/renderer/utils/provider hashes with each run. CUDA extension build compatibility changes remain separately audited. Upstream CUDA atomic backward nondeterminism is not claimed absent.
